It also connects ethical instruction — deacons 'likewise' must be dignified (1 Tim 3:8), older women 'likewise' reverent (Titus 2:3). Spanish 'asimismo' and 'del-mismo-modo' together capture both the connective and the manner-comparison functions, while German 'ebenso' concisely conveys 'just so.'"
